definitions.explanation: Identifying or singling out a particular item from among others. As a noun, refers to the act of specification or identification.

examples.japanese: {特定|とくてい}の{人物|じんぶつ}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: We are looking for a specific person.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}を{特定|とくてい}することができた。
examples.english: We were able to identify the culprit.

examples.japanese: {特定|とくてい}の{条件|じょうけん}を{満|み}たす{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to meet specific conditions.

notes:
USAGE: {特定|とくてい} functions as a no-adjective to mean 'specific/particular' and as a suru-verb to mean 'to identify/specify.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {特定|とくてい}の + noun (a specific ~)
- Xを{特定|とくてい}する (to identify/specify X)
- {特定|とくてい}される (to be identified)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {特定|とくてい}{個人|こじん} (specific individual)
- {特定|とくてい}{商品|しょうひん} (specific product)
- {身元|みもと}{特定|とくてい} (identification of identity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {特別|とくべつ} - special (emphasizes being exceptional)
- {特殊|とくしゅ} - special, unique (emphasizes rarity)
